request.style: English, male acoustic voice, solo, acoustic guitar, soft cello, gentle percussion, contemplative mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family line of Noah
Shem and Ham and Japheth born
Sons were born to them after the flood
The nations spread from the storm

[Verse]
The sons of Ham came from the water
Cush and Egypt and Put
Canaan was with them in the land
They moved out from the hut

[Chorus]
Seba and Havilah stand together
Sabtah and Raamah follow
Sabteca is listed in the text
From the roots that were hollow

[Verse]
The sons of Raamah are named here
Sheba and Dedan are found
In the genealogy of the earth
Where the peoples are bound

[Chorus]
Seba and Havilah stand together
Sabtah and Raamah follow
Sabteca is listed in the text
From the roots that were hollow

[Outro]
These are the sons of Ham
In their lands and nations
The line continues on
